objective: Factor exact common structured branch suffixes and name loop counters whose control guards continue into an exit suffix, preserving return/full guest memory/first modeled fault and effect order.

contracts.tail: branch_tail::factor(nodes:&[Node])->Option<Vec<Node>>. Recursively transform If and Loop, then remove exact structurally identical common suffix nodes from both If arms and append once after If. Step equality MUST include instruction address and ordered full assignments; no slot alias matching or instruction-address erasure (views are keyed by program point). All Expr and Node kinds count towards whole-input bounded validation before clone/equality. If both prefixes empty retain condition as Node::Evaluate (including pure conditions; later read analysis must see all reads). Otherwise retain If with unchanged condition and prefixes; no condition inversion needed. Break/Continue/Return and outer transfers remain at same loop depth; no reordering within any path. Return None on any bound failure, no partial result. Output nonexpanding modulo harmless Evaluate. No IR or certificate mutation.
contracts.roles: Keep value_role::infer API and bounds. Extend only conservative loop-control evidence: an If with one arm definitely continuing this loop and the other arm falling through to a definitely exiting continuation should count as loop-control guard. Consider nested conditional exit summaries and reachable continuation; distinguish nested-loop break/continue, outer transfers, stores/Evaluate as fallthrough, and both-continuing noncontrols. No value/control mutation or changed public name contract. Maintain existing negative test of continue-vs-fallthrough with following update (no actual exit).

criteria: mechanical structural laws and independent execution replay
ordered faults/loads, transfer scopes, negative pc/assignment cases
continue exit suffix and inverted/nested cases
existing counter negatives and bounds retained

writeScope: authoritative backend/module exports/native fixture and tests/docs/tools
criteria: native fixtures and ordered-fault C comparison
review then verified commits and snapshot audit cleanup

stop: One bounded branch presentation pass plus role refinement; verify concrete before/after improvements and native semantic comparisons, commit. No loop-unroll reversal or global SSA.
